summary: Validated P1 + P2 features for The Shirtless Handyman: PATCH /api/leads/{id}/status with admin + contractor auth scoping, GET /api/admin/leads N+1 batch fix, zippopotam.us ZIP geocoding + zip_cache MongoDB cache, graceful Twilio/Resend/auto-reply fallback, mobile-first LeadsInbox component. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed. Frontend: LeadsInbox renders all required elements (search, 4 filter pills, lead cards, call/text/email tap-targets, Mark-as-Contacted/Closed) on mobile viewport; search filtering works; status update PATCH integration succeeded. Regression checks on /, /admin all pass.

minor.issue: Pre-existing: @api_router.post('/seed') decorator appears to be re-attached correctly to seed_endpoint() now — confirmed working. (Was flagged in iteration_6.)

issues: Global Klaviyo signup popup ("See Your Room Transformed") auto-opens on the contractor dashboard, overlaying the LeadsInbox. This is a homeowner-targeted CTA and should be suppressed for authenticated contractor sessions. The LeadGenWidgets component is correctly excluded, but Klaviyo's script is loaded globally and not gated by route.

ExitIntentModal and Klaviyo signup can both open simultaneously, creating a double-modal stack that obscures the hero quote form. Consider suppressing Klaviyo when ExitIntentModal is already shown, or coordinating their triggers.

action_items: (UX) Gate the global Klaviyo signup popup so it does not show on /contractor/dashboard or /admin routes.
(UX) On mobile HomePage, avoid showing ExitIntentModal and Klaviyo popup simultaneously.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/leads/{id}/status correctly differentiates admin (any lead) vs contractor (only leads in their service_zip_codes or assigned). Filter uses Mongo $or for zip-or-assigned. Solid implementation.

get_zip_coords_async resolution order is correct: static map → MongoDB zip_cache → zippopotam.us → static prefix fallback. Verified live network call returned Las Vegas coords (36.126, -115.1454, NV) and cached the row.
notifications.send_homeowner_autoreply uses _normalize_phone helper for E.164 — good. Skip-warning log line is clear ('Homeowner auto-reply skipped — Twilio not configured').
admin_get_all_leads batching: collects contractor_ids first, performs one $in query, builds a dict map. N+1 fixed cleanly.
Minor: notifications module logs differentiate between RESEND_API_KEY missing and LEAD_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL missing in separate warnings now — improvement from iteration 6.
LeadsInbox component: search, filter, status update, optimistic UI via setUpdating, mobile-first sizing (h-11 tap targets). data-testid coverage is comprehensive.

seed_data_creation: Seeded 2 TEST_UI_ leads (Alice/Bob) via /api/leads from browser fetch, plus several TEST_StatusLead docs from pytest. Inserted 1 TEST_admin_batch_* lead directly to verify admin/leads contractor_name enrichment. Created zip_cache entry for ZIP 89109 (Las Vegas, NV).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P1/P2 backend and frontend acceptance criteria for this iteration are met. The two design issues (Klaviyo popup on dashboard, double-modal on mobile) are minor UX items, not blocking functionality. When RESEND_API_KEY/TWILIO_* are eventually populated, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py and verify supervisor logs show 'Lead email sent' / 'Lead SMS sent' / 'Homeowner auto-reply sent' instead of the skip warnings. The new /app/backend/tests/test_lead_status_and_zip.py is reusable for regression of PATCH status, batched admin/leads, and ZIP geocoding.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features under test passed. Two UX gating issues noted under design_issues are pre-existing Klaviyo script behavior and not part of this iteration's code changes.
